description.en: The ID of the CEN instance.

description.zh:
云企业网实例所属的阿里云账号ID。

- 如果配置的CenId属于本阿里云账号，该参数无需配置。

- 如果配置的CenId属于其他阿里云账号，请填写所属阿里云账号的ID。
description.en:
The Alibaba Cloud account to which the CEN instance belongs.

*   If you own the CEN instance, you can skip this parameter.
*   If you do not own the CEN instance, you must specify the ID of the account that owns the CEN instance.

description.zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~196646~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表。
description.en: The region ID. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~196646~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

description.zh: 验证码。如果配置的CenId属于其他阿里云账号，必须先调用[SendVerifyCode](~~436847~~)获取验证码。
description.en: The verification code. If you do not own the CEN instance, you must call the [SendVerifyCode](~~436847~~) operation to obtain a verification code.

title.zh: 将高级办公网络与云企业网实例绑定

descriptions.zh:
前提条件：
- 已有云企业网实例。
- 办公网络的类型为高级办公网络，且账号系统类型为便捷账号。

> AD办公网络在创建时已经加入到云企业网实例中。一个办公网络只能加入到一个云企业网实例中。
descriptions.en:
Prerequisites

*   A CEN instance is created.
*   The office network is an advanced office network, and the account system type is convenient account.

>  The office network is added to the CEN instance when you create the instance. An office network can be added to only one CEN instance.
